title: Greta Bornmann
text:
Hi! I am an Environmental Studies student at Chaminade University while also pursuing a Data Science and Business Entrepreneurship minor! I am passionate about helping the world become a better place with both my love for helping others and the environment.
My favorite things to do are surf, snowboard, rock climb, and paint! I also enjoying going to the beach and SHELLING. I have a small jewelry business called She Shells, check it out! :)

title: She Shells Jewlery
text:
Based off of the classic tongue twistier “She sells seashells by the seashore”, She Shells is a small business owned by me! I collect the shells locally and make all the jewelry myself. I started off doing this because I could not find exactly what I wanted, so I made it! After getting compliments from friends and coworkers, I signed up for two “pop-up” events and they were a success! I now make jewelry on the side and am currently pursuing bangle making.
